headline: Philippines establishes National AI Council and adopts an AI governance framework
body: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. established a National Artificial Intelligence Council under Executive Order No. 131, signed on November 12, and the country adopted a national AI Governance Framework, ABS-CBN News reported. The council must review the framework at least once every two years.
note: The order sets up a coordinating body for AI policy and regulation. Banks and fintechs in the Philippines may want to watch what the council issues.

evidence.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has established a National Artificial Intelligence Council (NAIC) to oversee the development and use of AI in the Philippines.
Under Executive Order No. 131, signed on 12 November, the country has also adopted a national AI Governance Framework, ABS-CBN News reported.
The NAIC must review the AI Governance Framework at least once every two years, or sooner if significant technological, regulatory or market developments warrant changes.
Executive Order 131 tasks the new council with coordinating AI policy and regulation, with the national framework due for review at least every two years.
